chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from 'Abd Allah ibn Yahya al-Kahili and al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said: We asked him about the deceased from whom something comes out after his ghusl has been completed. He said:
"That is washed, and the ghusl is not repeated for him."

key_terms.ذَلِكَ: that discharged matter or affected area
key_terms.غُسْلِهِ: his ritual washing of the dead body

ai.seo_question: If something comes out of a deceased person after the funeral ghusl, must the ghusl be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the deceased after the funeral ghusl has been completed. If something exits from the body afterward, that impurity is to be washed away, but the full ghusl of the deceased is not repeated.
